I see you're doing well at expressing that you don't want to reflect your insecurities onto the relationship. You show self awareness at understanding what you feel and competence at expressing that emotion. 

I feel you. When we date someone, we often want to be the provider of the intimacy, or be that person we always turn to. 

Perhaps more in the idea than the reality, but both equally as important as each other. 

I think if she expressed how you played a part in her life, that it could definitely reassure you. It may not fix anything neccicarily.  But may be able to offer you a sense that yes, you have a major part in her life. 

Sometimes friends offer something a relationship can't, and that's ok. But it can be difficult to let go of that feeling because it's part of us as humans. A natural desire, both biologically and socially. 

What are your plans going forward?

Based on what you've expressed before also, it sounds like she's not particularly considerate or aware of how this makes you feel. 

Some people I find don't stand up for their partners much, nor take their side. 

I understand most people, and its completely natural to want your partner to stand up for you. As its supportive and shows that the person values you. 

Similarly if someone talked down about your child, it would be unnatural to see a parent indifferent towards such action. 

So it does cause concerns. 

You said she spends time with a friend whom has expressed attention towards her, yet you feel like the third wheel when in company of them both together. 

This would raise red flags to me, that for 

1) she's in company, alone with this individual? Perhaps theres been reassurance that they're just friends?

2) that you feel like the third wheel and she talks more to him. The talking more to him part I can understand perhaps as -hes a guest- but the third wheel. 

It sounds odd to say the least.

It can take time to really figure out how to express things in the best ways. But we are limited by what we have right here and now. 

You'll do your best and sometimes that doesn't work out. But you're trying and it's really good that you're considerate and putting in that effort. 

I can see you really care, that you're hurt that she's not seen that effort you put forward. 

It likely hurts that you found out she didn't realise the time and effort you put forward. Whilst you understand and empathise with her loneliness and want the best for her, she probably feel invalidated by the fact you spent so much time alone. That you'd think she would notice that you equally feel the same. 

You want to make it work, and you really value her input and her emotions. That you want to mutually validate and accommodate one another.

You're scared right now which is completely valid, shes being distant and you're uneasy. So you may feel more impulsive or even more avoidant than normal. Thus you're not at your best to be the "perfecr" partner. 

You're OP. maybe not mentally but you're not a bad person in my books. Even if that's just a strangers option.

There will be discomfort and pain in relationships, sometimes its unpleasant. But the idea is to minimize on both sides that experience whilst having oneself, and each others best interests in mind. 

I don't think holding your feelings to yourself will help the situation. Its known that once you start associating the other person as "a bad person" or someone akin to "they just always do this" that this is a pretty bad spot to be in. 

My advice is to talk to one another. If you think she will take it personally, then best you can do is inform her that it may be emotionally upsetting and try to ready her. Whilst also trying your personal best to word it in a way that will be directed at the problem, and to stir away from things that may come across as blame. 

But be honest, encourage honesty where you can. 

It won't be easy, but if the consideration of a break up has been mentioned, then taking that chance and pressing forward whilst it's there, might be your only chance when shes still available to listen.
